build_zimage_auto_pipeline: build a ZImageAutoBlocks pipeline for text-to-image and image-to-image generation
run_zimage_core_denoise: run ZImageCoreDenoiseStep to denoise latents from encoded text conditions
run_zimage_image2image_denoise: run ZImageImage2ImageCoreDenoiseStep to denoise latents with image and text conditions
use_zimage_auto_denoise: use ZImageAutoDenoiseStep to auto-select text2image or image2image denoising
encode_image_with_vae: encode an image into latents using ZImageAutoVaeImageEncoderStep
